scope: Author research summaries; not schema source_assertions, approval or record draft. Exact structured source slots are bound separately.

facts.reason: Enzyme acceleration and spontaneous interconversion coexist; neither supports assigning every extract activity to this protein. Conditional low-concentration phenotype is not universal essentiality.
